bodyAsJson.subject: Case Reference Number {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}} \u2013 Intervener solicitor access
bodyAsJson.html:
Reference no: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}}

Your Ref: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.intervenerSolicitorReferenceNumber'}}

{{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.applicantName'}} vs {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.respondentName'}}

Dear {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.name'}},

{{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.intervenerSolicitorFirm'}} have been added as solicitors for the intervener {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.intervenerFullName'}} to the Financial Remedy proceedings between {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.applicantName'}} vs {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.respondentName'}}, and can access the case online.

You can now view case details by signing into https://manage-case.platform.hmcts.net/case/{{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}}

Help us improve this service

This is a new service which is still being developed. If you haven\u2019t already, please tell us what you think of it and how it can be improved at http://www.smartsurvey.co.uk/s/KCECE/.

If you need help
You can contact the court if you need help.

Hours: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.phoneOpeningHours'}}
